## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in San Antonio, United States. It starts at 849 E. Commerce St.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Leave your brickwork creations at home for the day and let loose in a LEGO® universe in the heart of San Antonio.
>
> There are 10 family-fun rides, attractions, and activities to be explored. Fight off trolls and skeletons to save the princess on the Kingdom Quest laser ride, and journey to the stars on Merlin's Apprentice. Got the mind of an engineer? Build tall towers and see if they can survive the rumbling tumbling Earthquake Tables!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €24.16. It was rated 3.9 out of 5 from 29 ratings and 15 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
